theorem_contract.boundaries: tangent and higher-order zeros are excluded from the simple-pole rate, but not from the Riccati breakdown criterion
theorem_contract.nonzero_criterion: forward breakdown iff omega0 has a zero; first time is min 2/abs(mu)*arccot(Homega0/abs(mu)) on that zero set
theorem_contract.one_mode: omega0=mu+A*sin(k*x) has the exact zero-free, tangent, crossing, and zero-mean clock regimes
theorem_contract.profile: at every simple first pole, (T-t)*omega(xstar+(T-t)*y,t) converges to the displayed rational profile locally; a global Theta rate needs all first poles simple
theorem_contract.zero_criterion: first positive time is min 2/Homega0 on zeros with Homega0 positive; empty set means forward global
